gold.user: As a conference organizer, I want to retrieve a list of all recordings for a specific conference so that I can review the discussions and share them with participants.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON array of recordings, including details such as the recording SID, duration, and date created.

gold.user: As a conference administrator, I want to update the metadata of a specific recording to correct the title and add a description for better context.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a JSON payload with updated title and description, and return the updated recording details.

gold.user: As a user, I want to fetch the details of a specific recording from a conference so that I can listen to it or download it.
gold.ideal: The API should return the recording details including the URL for playback and download options.

gold.user: As a conference manager, I want to delete a specific recording that is no longer needed to keep our records organized.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion with a success message and ensure the recording is no longer accessible.
